about: Vineyard area (ha) and production (hl) a registered name's own Wikipedia article gives in its text rather than its infobox — chiefly the German articles' «Im Jahr 2017 wurden von 908 Hektar Rebfläche 35.859 Hektoliter DOC-Wein erzeugt» and the French «La superficie plantée en vignes est de … hectares» — each with its sentence copied as written, its year where the article gives one and a link. Only a figure about the name itself: a sentence about another wine of the zone («Classico», «Superiore») is left out, and an area that would mean an impossible yield beside the name's production (more than 200 hl/ha, or a zone's whole area) is set aside by hand. scripts/kb/build-appellations.ts checks each quote against the article cached by scripts/kb/fetch-region-articles.ts.
